market.what: recycled polyamide (nylon) fiber, world; dye removal is the add-in step
market.method: ~6.2 Mt PA x 2% recycled = ~124 kt x ~$3.5/kg (est.); reports $1.3B and $4.2B incl. plastics, wide spread
market.job_what: dye/colour removal step in nylon recycling, world
market.job_method: est.: ~124 kt/yr recycled PA x ~$0.3/kg decolorization (est.; solvent stripping uses 15-60x fabric weight of solvent) = ~$40M; low confidence

value.logic: est.: unlock ~300 kt/yr dyed post-consumer nylon (now landfilled/burned) x ~$1/kg net (PA ~$2.5/kg minus ~$1.5/kg process)
value.revenue_logic: ~60 kt/yr nylon processed with our trap (30% of ~200 kt colored-PA recycling capacity, yr 7) x $0.15/kg
value.margin_logic: regenerable sorbent media or license to recycler

trend.drivers: EU textile separate collection (Jan 2025) and EPR (WFD revision Oct 2025); brand targets (lululemon 20% circular fiber by 2030)
trend.deadline: EU textile EPR schemes in place by 17 Apr 2028

indirect_startups: Samsara Eco (AU; enzymatic nylon 6,6, ~US$65M Series A+)
competition.notes: Aquafil runs PA6 depolymerization but mainly on nets/carpet, not dyed garments. DyeRecycle early (pre-seed).

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: O-sulfation of catalog calix[4]arene, 3 variants
lab.test: dyed PA6/PA66 (acid, metal-complex, disperse dyes) dissolved or in depolymerization liquor; dye uptake UV-Vis; reprecipitated PA color CIELAB; caprolactam purity (UV, permanganate no.); university polymer lab

sale.gates: recycler pilot (Aquafil/Samsara-type) 1-2 yr; yarn qualification by brands (GRS, OEKO-TEX) ~1 yr
